description:
Activate Myr Welder using Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Myr Welder using Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat.

uses.name: Myr Welder
uses.cardState: with two or more charge counters on it
